ios.name: NewsBlur: RSS News Reader
ios.subtitle: Follow sites. Find your focus.
ios.description:
Follow the sites you care about with NewsBlur, a personal RSS news reader that brings your reading together. Keep up with news, blogs, newsletters, and more, with your subscriptions and reading progress synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.

READ YOUR WAY
Browse stories from individual sites or bring a folder together in one reading list. Choose a comfortable theme, adjust the text, and use gestures to move through your stories. Download stories for offline reading and pick up where you left off.

STORIES AT A GLANCE
Add widgets to your Home Screen. Each widget can show All Site Stories, a folder, or one site. Choose its source with Edit Widget.

FIND YOUR FOCUS
Train NewsBlur on authors, tags, and words in headlines to highlight stories you want and hide ones you don't. You decide what matters.

DISCOVER AND KEEP
Find new sites, preview their latest stories, and try reading before subscribing. Save stories for later, organize them with tags, and search your reading. Share stories with comments on your NewsBlur blurblog and follow what friends are reading.

LISTEN TO YOUR STORIES
Turn articles into audio with voices in 21 languages. Follow highlighted paragraphs, tap to jump ahead, adjust playback speed, and queue stories in Up Next. Keep listening with the screen locked. Premium Archive includes 1 hour of listening per week, and Premium Pro includes 10 hours per week. Allowances reset every Sunday. Auto-continue follows your chosen list order in Saved Stories and Read Stories. Free and Premium accounts can try 30-second previews.

GO DEEPER
Use Text view to read an extracted article. Ask AI for a summary, background, or answers to questions about a story. Availability and usage limits depend on your account plan.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Use NewsBlur's interface in 21 languages, including right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Hebrew. Choose your language in Preferences or follow your device settings. Stories stay in the language they were published in.

A NewsBlur account is required. Free accounts and optional paid subscriptions are available. Some features require a paid plan.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
If you purchase a subscription through the App Store, payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.newsblur.com/tos
Privacy policy: https://www.newsblur.com/privacy
ios.promotional_text: Listen your way: start from the reading toolbar, skip with Next story, and play saved stories in order. Archive includes 1 hour a week; Pro includes 10.
